NuclearReactions.title: Nuclear reaction and channel accounting
NuclearReactions.statement: A nuclear reaction is a complete map between incident and outgoing composite words in which every material, energy, momentum and held conserved label is paired across the boundary.
NuclearReactions.generation_rule: Generate the complete constituent, composition/exchange, conserved-label, transition-channel, provenance, target-access, successor and extra-rule product.
NuclearReactions.grammar_boundary: All finite material forms generated from exact physical Fold words, held orientations, closed transfer, phase recurrence and complete observation support without imported particle taxonomy or fitted coupling.

choices.name: answer-only-scalar
choices.reason: An answer-only scalar erases the generated physical carrier.

choices.name: complete-fold-carrier
choices.reason: The complete Fold trace retains the observed physical distinction.

choices.name: imported-or-fitted-relation
choices.reason: An imported or fitted relation lets consensus or target data select the law.

choices.name: complete-nuclear-channel-accounting
choices.reason: Exhaustive input/output support is the only form that preserves all physical carriers and makes missing channels falsifiable.

choices.name: unbound-provenance
choices.reason: Unbound provenance cannot demonstrate which premises produced the result.

choices.name: source-bound-proof-trace
choices.reason: Every generated candidate and decision is bound to its exact source trace.

choices.name: target-readable-prediction
choices.reason: A target-readable predictor can copy or optimize against the measurement.

choices.name: capability-closed-prediction
choices.reason: The registered Fold instruction surface has no target or ambient host capability.

choices.name: proof-measurement-conflation
choices.reason: Treating an external decimal record as a proof scalar violates the measured-value boundary.

choices.name: separate-measurement-record
choices.reason: External values remain source-bound records compared only after sealing.

choices.name: selected-favourable-rows
choices.reason: Selecting favorable rows cannot falsify the relation.

choices.name: complete-registered-rows
choices.reason: Every favorable, unfavorable and tampered registered row is retained.

choices.name: finite-answer-lookup
choices.reason: An answer lookup has no successor certificate.

choices.name: one-successor-closure
choices.reason: The One base and generated successor preserve the relation at every declared finite depth.

choices.name: free-extra-rule
choices.reason: A free constant, scale or exception can select the measured answer.

choices.name: no-extra-rule
choices.reason: No rule beyond the admitted dependencies and forced relation is present.

NuclearReactions.exact_result: Nuclear reactions are exact closed maps across complete generated incident and product channels.
NuclearReactions.induction_base: One constituent is one complete recurrent physical Fold word carrying its observable and held labels with source provenance.
NuclearReactions.induction_step: Adding one constituent or transition channel preserves every prior label, conservation and composition trace and appends exactly its generated joint support.
exclusions: ungenerated continuum or completed infinite species set
floating, irrational, imaginary or signed proof magnitude
imported particle table, fitted coupling or target-selected species
target access, omitted decay/reaction channel or unrecorded constituent
operational_witnesses: Every constituent retains one source-bound state and transition trace.
Every transition has complete input and output carrier support.

target_rows.source_locator: IAEA ENDF cross-section and product-yield records

NuclearReactions.falsification_condition: The material law is falsified if a committed external row lacks the sealed constituent/composition/conservation structure, a row is omitted, or the tampered row is accepted.
